meta.name: learn-rule
meta.description: Capture a correction or lesson as a persistent learning rule with category, mistake, and correction. Stores, categorises, and retrieves rules for future sessions. Use after mistakes or when the user says "remember this", "don't forget", "note this", or "learn from this".

copy.tagline: 把每次纠正或教训存成可复用的学习规则
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常犯同类错误或想记住重要经验
copy.tagline_en: Save each correction or lesson as a reusable learning rule
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often repeat mistakes or want to remember key lessons

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 当你说“记住这个”或指出错误时，Claude 会帮你把教训整理成一条学习规则，包含分类、错误和改正方法，并保存下来供以后参考。
howto.when: 当你说了“记住这个”、“添加到规则”、“别再那样做”等话，或者 Claude 发现你犯了错误时触发。

say.text: 记住这个：编辑文件前先确认路径。
say.note: Claude 会生成一条导航类规则并请求你确认。

say.text: 添加到规则：测试覆盖率低于80%时不要合并。
say.note: Claude 会创建一条测试类规则。

howto.what_en: When you say 'remember this' or point out a mistake, Claude captures the lesson as a persistent learning rule with category, mistake, and correction, and stores it for future sessions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say 'remember this', 'add to rules', 'don't do that again', or after a mistake is identified.

say_en.text: Remember this: confirm the file path before editing.
say_en.note: Claude will propose a Navigation rule and ask for approval.

say_en.text: Add to rules: don't merge if test coverage is below 80%.
say_en.note: Claude will create a Testing rule.
